primary_target.name: volume_kwh
primary_target.description: Total electric energy dispensed to vehicles during the 1-hour window.
primary_target.interpretation: Electrical energy demand / grid load. Does NOT measure session count.
primary_target.limitations: Influenced by charger power capacities (fast DC vs slow AC) and vehicle acceptance rates.

secondary_metric.name: occupancy_piles
secondary_metric.description: Average number of concurrently occupied charging piles during the 1-hour window.
secondary_metric.interpretation: Infrastructure bay utilization. Does NOT measure session arrival counts.
secondary_metric.limitations: Saturates at maximum zone pile capacity; does not differentiate power levels.

auxiliary_features.duration_hours: Cumulative vehicle plug-in duration (hours) across active piles.
auxiliary_features.s_price: Charging service fee during the hour (Yuan/kWh).
